answer: Cedar-ledger peer audit bond: each identity locks 70 and posts one signed work to the cedar ledger. Each epoch a beacon picks random entries; a stranger re-runs the work and stamps a lotus mark on a match. A hollow entry fails and burns the bond. First fake pays 55, k-th 55+4(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 2,053,000 plus 70,000 locked against a 40,000 pool. Rented auditors fail, the peer showing its own rerun; honest agents pay 55 once and keep the bond.
